business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Every product runs on the shared Veefin 4.0 chassis — one architecture, one integration layer, one operational core.
- Third-party recognition: #1 on the IBSi Sales League Table (Wholesale Transaction Banking), Industry Leader on the IBSi SCF Spectrum (repeat placement across two consecutive editions), and Euromoney Awards 2025 World's Most Innovative Software Provider for Supply Chain Finance.
- 50+ institutions across 16 countries run Veefin in production, enabling $47B+ in annualized disbursements — the installed base each quarter's new wins layer onto.
- Q1 FY27 flagship wins were multi-product/multi-country: a GCC digital bank adopted 6 products (LOS, LMS, Collections, Trade Finance, SCF, Limits Microservice), a Middle East NBFC adopted the full 3-product lending stack, and a Pan-Africa SCF win spanned 5 countries — reflecting a shift from single-product to platform selling.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: Standalone: SCF dominates revenue; Product Platform (Veefin+Estorifi+GlobeTF): INR 91.75cr revenue, INR 44.7cr EBITDA (48.7% margin); PSB Xchange: 32 lender integrations (3 live), 42 sourcing partner integrations (6 live), INR 22,000cr cumulative requirements, INR 5,400cr approved limits

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: $80M qualified pipeline across 58 banking clients; 75% non-SCF; 70% international (Southeast Asia, Middle East, South Asia); 27/58 banks evaluating >1 product

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: revenue growth: implied >50% YoY (based on pipeline conversion); margin: stable/high (product IP capex declining); order inflow: 25% of $80M pipeline to convert in next 6 months; capex/commissioning: FY27 capex to be lower than FY26's INR 187cr (consolidated); product IP build-out nearing completion

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: International expansion (6 countries in active JV talks); White Rivers Media listing (DRHP expected Sep 2026); PSB Xchange monetization from throughput; cross-sell within existing bank relationships

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: EBITDA margin 53.89% (standalone) driven by product IP scalability; higher depreciation/finance costs pressured PAT margin; FY27 capex decline expected to improve PAT margin

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Amalgamation of Veefin, Estorifi, GlobeTF to simplify structure; White Rivers Media to be spun off via separate listing; focus on monetizing existing IP over new builds; no dividend policy disclosed

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident, strategic, and execution-focused; management emphasizes 'boring' FY27 as monetization phase; dismisses 'spreading thin' concerns; highlights moat creation via PSB Xchange ecosystem; clear shift from product-building to sales discipline and enterprise selling

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Execution risk on pipeline conversion; PSB Xchange throughput delay; regulatory delays in amalgamation; international JV execution; dependency on bank integration cycles

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: PSB Xchange's INR 5,400cr approved limits are the true leading indicator — disbursements will follow as limits are bifurcated to suppliers/dealers; 65 bps pricing includes 15 bps for Veefin's own onboarding team (on payroll), creating a sticky service moat; 70% international pipeline is not speculative — active deals in SEA/Middle East are already in contract negotiation

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Amalgamation] Structural simplification scheme to consolidate the group into one listed product-company perimeter; appointed date 1 April 2026; 4 of 7 statutory stages complete — BSE/SEBI NOC, NCLT first motion, stakeholder meetings and Chairman's report are done; NCLT petition filing is next, with statutory NOCs and the final NCLT order still pending.
- [Reporting Structure] Deck frames three distinct reporting lenses: management view (integrated platform build and execution across group entities), standalone numbers (Veefin Solutions Ltd. product revenue/profitability, the core operating economics), and consolidated numbers (statutory group including subsidiaries with different margins, PAT split between owners and non-controlling interests).
